responses.text: {"kind":"chart","alt":"Line chart of public elementary and secondary school enrollment in millions from fall 2010 to fall 2021 for the total, prekindergarten through grade 8, and grades 9 through 12.","latex":"","chartSummary":"Total and prekindergarten through grade 8 enrollment held near 50 and 35 million through 2019, then dropped in 2020 and stayed lower in 2021, while grades 9 through 12 rose slowly to about 15.4 million.","chartData":{"columns":["Year","Total (millions)","Prekindergarten through grade 8 (millions)","Grades 9 through 12 (millions)"],"rows":[["2010","49.5","34.5","15.0"],["2015","50.3","35.4","15.1"],["2019","50.8","35.6","15.3"],["2020","49.4","34.1","15.3"],["2021","49.4","34.0","15.4"]]},"extractedText":""}
